name: Xipe Totec
subtitle: The Flayed One
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: The Flayed One represents conflicting elements that feed one another, such as war and agriculture, death and sustenance, opposing seasons. Indirectly, he symbolizes the core of Omeyocan faith: power from sacrifice. Thus, the existence of realms that function differently is not only a cosmic danger but, for him, a personal affront, driving him to lead battles against them and terrify their worshipers.
divinity_generator: Gain [20] Divinity when inflicting damage to an enemy under [Bleed].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Expose Flesh
skills.description: Attack all enemies 330%ATK with an 80% chance to place [mechanic:curse-ii] on all targets for 2 turns. If a target is defeated, spread 2 stacks of [mechanic:bleed] to all targets. If a target is defeated with 10 stacks of [mechanic:bleed], this hero gains an [Extra Turn].
skills.awakening_bonus: If this hero gain’s an [Extra Turn], reset the Core Ability.

skills.name: Haemorrhage
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 350%ATK with a 75% chance to place 1 stack of [mechanic:bleed] on the target. Strong Hits place 2 stacks instead.

skills.name: Flayed Feast
skills.description: When below 50% HP, attacks remove 2 stacks of [mechanic:bleed] and Heal [10%HP] per stack removed. When above 50% HP, Increase Strong Hit chance by 2% per [mechanic:bleed] on target.

skills.name: Ritual Flay
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 400%ATK with a 80% place 3 stacks of [mechanic:bleed] on the target then attack all enemies 400%ATK. If the initial target has 10 stacks of [mechanic:bleed] the second hit will activate all stacks of [mechanic:bleed] on all targets.
skills.awakening_bonus: Increase this hero’s Divinity by 1% for each stack of [Bleed] that was activated. Strong Hit also increase this hero’s Turn Meter by 1%.

imprint_passive: When below 50% HP, attacks remove 2 stacks of [Bleed] and Heal 5%HP per stack removed. When above 50% HP, Increase Strong Hit chance by 2% per [Bleed] on target.
